notes: The constructor mints all 1e27 units to its deployer. The factory sends 10% through its Merkle distributor and seeds 90% in the MUSEGOD/IMD Uniswap v4 pool; it forwards rounding remainder to remainderTo. All outflows from the fixed PoolManager incur a 2% token fee to the fixed treasury; inputs and other transfers are untaxed. Pool fee 12500 is the separate Uniswap LP fee. initialPrice is provenance; the factory derives opening price from economics and deployed currency order. No administrator, mint or burn.
